description: This file defines the class SugarCacheAPC, which extends the abstract class SugarCacheAbstract. It implements caching functionalities using the APC (Alternative PHP Cache) extension, including methods to store, retrieve, delete, and reset cache entries specifically for APC.

classes.name: SugarCacheAPC
classes.description: A class implementing caching using APC, extending SugarCacheAbstract.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if APC cache should be used by checking for APC functions and configuration.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Stores a value in APC cache for the given key.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves a value from APC cache by key.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry in APC for the given key.
